neighbours.label: verbs of restless or showy walking: pacing, strutting, parading, strolling
fire: Unable to sleep, she spent the night pacing the hallway.
The nervous father kept pacing outside the delivery room.
The rooster strutted across the yard as if he owned the farm.
The lion was pacing restlessly along the fence of its enclosure.
Models strutted down the runway in the designer's new coats.
He paced up and down the platform waiting for the late train.
The peacock strutted through the garden with its tail spread wide.
On Sundays the couple liked to promenade along the river.
quiet: Unable to sleep, she spent the night reading in the hallway.
The nervous father kept waiting outside the delivery room.
The rooster stood in the yard as if he owned the farm.
The lion was lying lazily along the fence of its enclosure.
Models posed for photos in the designer's new coats.
He sat on a bench on the platform waiting for the late train.
The pigeon rested in the garden with its wings folded.
On Sundays the couple liked to picnic along the river.
